title: Boss bar with head icon, numbers and damage trail; invasion progress bar
player_outcome: A framed boss bar appears at the bottom-centre with the boss's head, a red fill that leaves a pale 'damage chunk' trailing behind, and 'current/max' life. Paired bosses share one bar. During invasions a bottom-right panel shows the event icon, its name and a progress bar with a percentage.
design:
Core: new src/Strata.Core/Presentation/BossBarModel.cs. `static BossBarState? Compute(IEnumerable<Npc> npcs)` returns (Title, IconId, Life, Max).
- Picks the dominant non-minor living boss by MaxLife.
- Sums every living npc sharing Boss.Flag, which covers pairs; worm segments are one Npc.
- Moves the logic out of Hud.UpdateBossBar (Hud.cs:228-247).
- Also add `ActiveEvent.Progress` (Kills / KillGoal).
BossInfo (EnemyDef.cs) gains `string? Icon` (default: the enemy id).

New game/UI/Hud/BossBar.cs in the BossBar rect.
- A 40 px icon TextureRect from BossIcons (assets/icons/bosses/<icon>.png; fallback: a coloured disc with the initial).
- A _Draw bar of 456×22: bg Color8(30,10,20,200), fill (200,30,50), 3 px top highlight (255,120,120,160), 2 px black frame.
- A damage chunk in (255,200,200,180) that MoveTowards the real value after 0.4 s.
- A centred 14 px 'life/max' label and an 18 px title above.
- Fades in when the boss spawns.
New game/UI/Hud/EventProgressPanel.cs in the EventBar rect, for the latest Events.Active with KillGoal > 0: icon (StatusIcons), name, bar, 'NN%'. On Events.Ended it shows 100%, then fades after 3 s.
Hud: remove the old boss panel. Setting BossBar and EventBar in UiState drives ApplyLayout.
files_modify: game/UI/Hud.cs — BossBar and EventProgressPanel wiring, old panel removed
data_changes: BossInfo optional `icon`; no edits needed (defaults to the id)
tests: BossBarModelTests: TwinsCombineIntoOneBar (retinazer + spazmatism share a flag); MinorBossesIgnored; WormCountsOnce

ui.cmds:
- `boss king_slime 12` / `wait 1` / `assert ui.bossbar == 1` / `killall` / `wait 1` / `assert ui.bossbar == 0`.
- `event goblin_army` / `wait 1` / `assert ui.eventbar == 1` / `event stop goblin_army`.
verification: Headless smoke; lavapipe screenshots of the King Slime bar and the Goblin Army progress
risks: The bosses phase adds separately killable Parts (Skeletron hands, Golem fists). Agree that BossBarModel includes a part only when it has its own life and is flagged, e.g. `countsOnBar`; Terraria shows only Skeletron's head.
